tools.name: Rebuke
limitations: Melee range
Single target
Fifteen-second cooldown

tools.name: Cleanse Toxins
limitations: Does not remove harmful Magic effects
Eight-second cooldown

tools.name: Hammer of Justice
limitations: Single-target stun
Only affects stunnable enemies

tools.name: Blinding Light
limitations: Breaks after sufficient non-Holy damage
Does not affect every creature type

tools.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
limitations: Transfers prevented damage to the Paladin
Ends before transferred damage would reduce the Paladin below twenty percent health

tools.name: Blessing of Protection
limitations: Protects against physical damage and effects
Causes Forbearance
Can cause the target to lose enemy aggression

tools.name: Intercession
limitations: Requires a dead ally
Uses the shared combat-resurrection limit

tools.name: Devotion Aura
limitations: Only affects allies within the aura range

tools.name: Divine Shield
limitations: Personal immunity only
Causes Forbearance
May require cancellation or coordination while actively tanking

tools.name: Avenger's Shield
limitations: Only the primary target is interrupted and silenced
Additional bounces deal damage but are not equivalent interrupts
Can conflict with planned interrupt assignments

tools.name: Blessing of Spellwarding
limitations: Replaces and shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection
Magic immunity does not remove existing effects
Causes Forbearance

tools.name: Blessing of Freedom
limitations: Movement-impairing effects only
Does not remove unrelated harmful Magic effects

provenance.description: Current Protection Paladin ability guide identifies Rebuke, Cleanse Toxins, control, auras, and blessing utility.
Current Cleanse Toxins record confirms friendly Poison and Disease removal and its cooldown.
Current Blessing of Sacrifice record confirms the external damage reduction, transfer, range, and stop condition.
Current Patch 12.1.0 Protection dungeon guide repeats Avenger's Shield, Cleanse, Blessing of Spellwarding, and Blessing of Freedom as its core dungeon utility and supplies affix recommendations.
Current spell records confirm Avenger's Shield's primary-target interrupt, Spellwarding's ally Magic immunity, and Freedom's movement-impairment immunity.
